description: Source code for world query functions in the Unvanquished game, including entity management, spatial partitioning, visibility checks, and collision detection.

classes.name: worldEntity_t
classes.description: Represents an entity within the spatial partitioning system, linked to a world sector.

classes.name: worldSector_t
classes.description: Spatial partition node used for dividing the world space for efficient entity queries.

classes.name: areaParms_t
classes.description: Parameters used for area-based entity queries.

classes.name: moveclip_t
classes.description: Structure used for collision detection during movement traces.

methods.name: G_CM_WorldEntityForGentity
methods.description: Converts a gentity_t pointer to its corresponding worldEntity_t.

methods.name: G_CM_GEntityForWorldEntity
methods.description: Converts a worldEntity_t pointer back to its gentity_t.

methods.name: G_CM_SetBrushModel
methods.description: Sets the model for an entity based on a brush model name.

methods.name: G_CM_ClipHandleForEntity
methods.description: Returns a clip handle for collision detection for a given entity.

methods.name: G_CM_inPVS
methods.description: Checks if two points are potentially visible to each other, considering portals.

methods.name: G_CM_inPVSIgnorePortals
methods.description: Checks visibility between two points without considering portals.

methods.name: G_CM_AdjustAreaPortalState
methods.description: Opens or closes an area portal based on entity state.

methods.name: G_CM_EntityContact
methods.description: Checks if an entity's bounding box contacts another entity.

methods.name: G_CM_AreaEntities
methods.description: Returns a list of entities within a specified bounding box.

methods.name: G_CM_Trace
methods.description: Performs a collision trace through the world and entities.

methods.name: G_Trace2
methods.description: Performs a collision trace and returns detailed hit information.
